verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents card authorization controls that set rules on how and where each issued card may be used (docs-3). It also markets corporate cards with spend controls (docs-20), alongside issuing and managing cards at scale (docs-2), which covers the core of granular per-card controls. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of per-card spend limit amounts or intervals, explicit per-employee card assignment or control management, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
